def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    # find full separator line (row or col) of one color

    for j in range(w):

        for i in range(h):
            val=g[i][0]
            if all(v==val for v in g[i]) and cnt[val]==w: sep=i;vert=False;break
    def region(cells):
        cc=Counter(v for r in cells for v in r); return cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
